thread:
Laura: FYI — we've got a support escalation. Multiple customers (acme-inc, hyperdrive, datawave) reporting canary rollout health chart stuck on 'in progress' in Console even though backend rollout status is COMPLETED.

Laura: Repro steps I used:
1) Start a canary via Console UI
2) Confirm rollout status via API: GET /api/rollouts/{id}/status returns COMPLETED
3) Console shows the canary tile as 'in progress' indefinitely.

Laura: Example API response from customer env:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.ai/api/rollouts/rollout-123/status
# {"id":"rollout-123","status":"COMPLETED","finished_at":"2026-03-15T12:34:56Z"}
```

Laura: Console UI screenshot attached in thread (customer). They say it blocks their next steps; one flagged as P1 for us. Tagging oncall: @Alex and releases: @Sanjay :eyes:

Alex: Thanks Laura — adding initial triage notes. Do we have logs from the rollout-sync service? My first guess is status-sync not emitting the UI update event.

Alex: Quick checks you can run for me:
- Check /api/rollouts/{id}?refresh=true and see if it returns status COMPLETED (force fetch)
- Check the rollout-sync service logs for entries like `emitting ui_update` or errors around the rollout id

Alex: Example curl I tried from my end (repro):
```
curl -X GET "https://console.redwood.ai/api/rollouts/rollout-123?refresh=true" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# returns {"id":"rollout-123","status":"COMPLETED","ui_state":"in_progress"}
```

Sanjay: I'm looking at the releases timeline — we shipped rollout-sync v2.7.4 on 2026-03-10 which touched the status propagation path. There's a known change that defers UI notifications when upstream ack latency >500ms. Could be the regression.

OpsBot: [monitoring] Alert: console-rollout-sync-errors spike at 2026-03-15T12:30Z — 78 errors in 5m window. Incident INC-8467 created.

Mira: From product side — customers see the canary as 'in progress' so they can't trigger automated rollback or promote. It's causing real workflow blockage. Can we provide a customer-facing workaround while we triage?

Alex: Short-term workaround: force refresh endpoint or reopen the rollout detail page which triggers a direct read from rollout store.
Workaround curl:
```
GET /api/rollouts/{id}?refresh=true
```
This should show correct status for now. I'll also add a temporary UI banner pointing to the support article.

Laura: I've communicated the workaround to customers and opened support tickets (SUP-6521, SUP-6528). They've asked for ETA.

Sanjay: Plan: revert rollout-sync to v2.7.3 on canary for the console region (eu-west-1) and run a smoke test. ETA 30-45 mins if rollback passes. If rollback isn't safe, I'll patch the null-path that suppresses notifications when ack latency is high.

Mira: Please keep me posted — I need copy for the status update.

Alex: I'll collect logs and a minimal repro and post them here. For triage: include `correlation_id` from customer request and the rollout id. That helps locate the exact sync trace.

Laura: Adding correlation ids for affected tickets in the incident.

Sanjay: Rolling back now to v2.7.3 on canary regions. I'll update in ~20m. :thumbsup:

Mira: Thanks everyone. Please ping me once rollback verified and we can notify customers.

OpsBot: [incident] INC-8467 updated: rollback started by sanjay at 2026-03-15T12:52:00Z.

Alex: After rollback verified, we'll run a follow-up to add more robust state reconciliation between rollout store and UI to prevent future 'in progress' stuck states.

Laura: Customers notified of workaround and that we're rolling back. Leaving thread open for updates.
